description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity of an Android weather app, managing UI components, ViewModel interactions, view pager setup, and user interactions like search and refresh.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity of the weather app managing UI, ViewModel, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI components, ViewPager, search, refresh, and loads default weather data.

methods.name: initViews
methods.description: Finds and assigns UI components to properties.

methods.name: setupViewPager
methods.description: Sets up the view pager with an adapter and tab layout mediator.

methods.name: setupSearch
methods.description: Configures search button and input to trigger weather search.

methods.name: setupRefresh
methods.description: Sets up refresh button to reload weather data.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Retrieves query from input, triggers weather search, and clears input.
